findings: Sentence 3 of résumé B (benzecri1960_ch1.tex l.96–98) is false as printed in dimension 0: « Le revêtement universel d'une variété localement affine compacte, considérée comme ouvert étalé au-dessus de l'espace affin, a une projection non bornée ». A compact locally affine 0-manifold is finite and its universal cover is a point. Every subset of ℝ⁰ is bounded, so no projection is unbounded (resultB_isBounded_dim_zero). Formalized: ResultBTroisiemePrinted n ↔ 0 < n (resultBTroisiemePrinted_iff), with the witness V = ℝ⁰ (compact, Hausdorff, connected, second countable, charted on itself); for n ≥ 1 it is proved (resultB_troisieme, resultB_projection_non_bornee). The cited Ch. 2 § 3 Prop. 1 (benzecri1960_ch2.tex l.648–654) fails in dimension 0 in the same way (projectionNonBorneePrinted_iff, T-bz-c2-projection). This is OQ-45 (a)'s question (is n ≥ 1 implied throughout?). No new OQ is opened, per the dispatch.
questions: OQ-45 (a), recorded, not ruled. Does sentence 3 (l.96–98) presume n ≥ 1? Reading taken: sentence 3 is stated for n ≥ 1 ([NeZero n]), and n = 0 is recorded as a counterexample (finding 1). Under (a), sentence 3 holds as printed. Under a reading that keeps n = 0, sentence 3 is false and the row stays partial. Sentences 1–2 hold in every dimension, so they do not depend on the answer.

« le revêtement universel » (l.81, 87, 91, 96). Reading taken: Benzecri.UniversalCover V v₀ with the pulled-back structure. The general forms cover every simply connected covering π : N → V whose structure makes π a morphism. If V is not connected, this is the universal cover of the component of v₀, the convention of Benzecri.UniversalCoverRow. Content-neutral for the paper's connected « variété ».

« s'identifie à un ouvert / à un convexe / à l'intérieur d'un corps convexe » (l.88, 93). Reading taken: there is a compatible chart (Ch. 1 Déf. 13) with source W whose target is that set, as in the formalization of Ch. 2 § 3 1° (theoreme_premier). It is also proved that the chart induces φ on P, or equals the given projection p. Content-neutral.

« W considéré comme ouvert étalé, a une projection sur la sphère projective dont la fermeture est incluse dans un hémisphère ouvert » (l.91–93). Reading taken: « projection » is a developing map p : W → S(n) (Ch. 1 Prop. 2; unique up to GS(n, ℝ)), and « dont la fermeture » is the closure of p(W), as in Prop. 2 (benzecri1960_ch2.tex l.722). The conclusion is proved for EVERY such p, so « a une » and « la » do not have to be told apart. « hémisphère ouvert » is Déf. 5 as printed (Sphere.IsOpenHemisphere; its degenerate l = 0 gives ∅, which a nonempty closure cannot lie in). Content-neutral.

« a une projection non bornée » (l.98). Reading taken: there is a developing map W → ℝⁿ, and every one has unbounded image. Two developing maps differ by an element of GA(n, ℝ), which preserves boundedness, so « une » and « toute » agree. Content-neutral.
« un convexe » (l.88) is read as Ch. 1 Déf. 8 in its ∪ reading (DEC-120). The image is proved strict (Déf. 9), so the conclusion also holds in the Minkowski reading. Content-neutral.

kb_proposals: Statements about « le revêtement universel »: prove them for any simply connected covering π : N → V, with [ChartedSpace X N] [HasGroupoid N _] and IsGXMorphism π. Divisibility comes from isDivisible_of_isCoveringMap and Hausdorffness from resultB_t2Space_of_isCoveringMap. Then specialise to UniversalCover V v₀ through the components of revetement_universel_divisible_proj/_aff (covering, simply connected, morphism). A non-vacuity witness then needs no computation inside UniversalCover: give N concretely and take V := N/Γ (Structure/Quotient: hasGroupoid_quotient, isGXMorphism_quotientMk, and isQuotientCoveringMap_quotientMk_of_properlyDiscontinuousSMul.isCoveringMap).

A compact locally projective 1-manifold whose universal cover is explicit: the Hopf circle ]0, ∞[ / 2^ℤ (Applications/TheoremB: resultBHopfGroup, resultB_nonVacuite_hopf). Its universal cover ]0, ∞[ carries the strict shell ]0, 1[ ≠ W with a non-constant cote, and satisfies the hemisphere condition. Proper discontinuity comes from the min and max of the coordinate on two compacts and resultB_le_natCeil_of_two_zpow_le. The compact fundamental domain [1, 2] comes from Mathlib's exists_mem_Ico_zpow.

Pitfall: under `attribute [local instance] projOfAff`, a quotient N/Γ of an affine N has two ChartedSpace (S n) instances. projOfAff applies to the quotient's affine charts, and MulAction.instChartedSpaceQuotient comes from N's projective charts. hasGroupoid_quotient and isGXMorphism_quotientMk use the latter, so `letI` it before calling them (« synthesized type class instance is not definitionally equal »).
At mathlib fabf563a the set in ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul is {γ | ((γ • ·) '' K ∩ L).Nonempty}, not `≠ ∅`: destructure membership as ⟨_, ⟨x, hxK, rfl⟩, hxL⟩.

Does theorem X use lemma Y (the OQ-dependency question of a roadmap [r] point)? Copy the module to /tmp and append a small `elab` command. It walks Expr.getUsedConstants over each constant's type and value (ConstantInfo.value? (allowOpaque := true)) from X and reports which watched names it reaches. Run the copy with `lake env lean /tmp/…`, which writes nothing in the package. T-bz-result-b-proj used it for OQ-71/OQ-75.

Closure of the interior of a convex body lies in an open hemisphere: resultB_exists_hemisphere_of_target, via IsCorpsConvexeS.exists_forall_pos. So the chart that 4° gives for a strict shell meets Prop. 2's hypothesis (resultB_coque_stricte_hemisphere).
notes: STATUS partial, unmarked per the dispatch. Two things are missing for the row. First, the affine half of sentence 1, T-bz-result-b's: its pocket part is Ch. 2 § 3's affine 1° (PremierAffine), its shell part the affine 3° (T-bz-c2-theoreme-affine). Second, sentence 3 at n = 0 (OQ-45 (a), finding 1). Everything else is proved with no sorry and standard axioms only (#print axioms checked on the principal declarations and on the witnesses): the sentence l.81–84 (both cases), sentence 1's projective half, sentence 2 (both clauses), and sentence 3 for n ≥ 1. All are proved first for every simply connected covering of a compact Hausdorff V, then for UniversalCover V v₀, then as printed over the paper's manifolds (ResultBProjPrinted n for every n; ResultBTroisiemePrinted n ↔ 0 < n). THE [r] POINT (OQ-71/OQ-75), checked on the proof terms. Every declaration of the file was walked by a transitive closure over the used constants of types and values. None reaches 1°'s second sentence: closure_inter_preimage_subset_poche, poche_eq_connectedComponentIn, poche_eq_preimage_iff, closure_poche_subset_preimage_hemisphere, poche_eq_preimage_of_cote_eq_zero, theoreme_premier, theoreme_poche_balayable, situation_exemple, PremierPrinted, ConnexePrinted, premierPrinted_iff, PremierComposantePrinted, TheoremePrinted. PremierAffine (OQ-75) is not even imported. Result B uses 1°'s first sentence (exists_chart_poche, i.e. 1°a exists_isDeveloping_eqOn_poche and 1°b injective_of_isDeveloping_of_poche), 3° (theoreme_troisieme), 4° (theoreme_quatrieme) and Prop. 2 (hemisphere_corps_convexe). The planner's [r] reading is confirmed, so OQ-71 and OQ-75 do not reach this row, and its mark follows OQ-45 (a) alone, once T-bz-result-b adds the affine half. The closure does contain IsPocheProj.ligne_brisee_poche and septieme_majore. These are the « ≤ » forms of Prop. 6 and property 7°, true for every pocket, reached through Prop. 7. OQ-61 does not reach the row either: under its answer (a) pockets become fewer, and statements quantified over all IsPocheProj only get stronger. The Hopf witness takes its strict shell from exists_isCoqueStricteAff_demiDroite_ne_univ, not from theoreme_poche_balayable_demiDroite, so that it too stays clear of 1°c. NON-VACUITY. (1) resultB_nonVacuite_hopf, n = 1, non-degenerate: V = ]0, ∞[ / 2^ℤ is compact, Hausdorff and locally projective, and ]0, ∞[ → V is a simply connected covering and a projective morphism. The strict shell P = ]0, 1[ ≠ ]0, ∞[ gives the conclusion of sentence 2, and the hemisphere hypothesis of sentence 2 holds too. This is the general-covering form (resultB_coque_stricte). The universal cover itself is not computed, so the UniversalCover forms are witnessed only by (3). (2) resultB_troisieme_hopf: S(m) × S¹ with the affine structure of Theorem A, for every m, is compact and locally affine of dimension m + 1 ≥ 1, and sentence 3 holds for its universal cover. (3) resultB_nonVacuite_dim_zero: for V = S(0), UniversalCover (S 0) x has a strict shell (P = W, z = 0) and a projection whose closure lies in an open hemisphere. Degenerate, but on UniversalCover itself. (4) resultB_revetementUniversel_sphere: V = S(n). REMARK, not a finding: in sentence 2 a strict shell implies the hemisphere clause's hypothesis, through 4° (resultB_coque_stricte_hemisphere), because the closure of the interior of a convex body lies in an open hemisphere. Hausdorffness of W is not in the strict library and is proved here (resultB_t2Space_of_isCoveringMap, the local version of lean-gx's t2Space_of_isCoveringMap in GX/Branched/Universality.lean).
